Running Shoe Mileage Tracker

Track mileage across your running shoes and get a replacement alert when a pair passes 500 km.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Replace shoes flagged past 500 km — worn cushioning raises injury risk.

📖 How to use

  1. Add each pair of running shoes by name.
  2. Log every run: pick the shoe, date, and distance in km.
  3. Watch per-shoe totals grow in the mileage table.
  4. Replace any shoe flagged past the 500 km warning.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I track a shoe?

Add a shoe, then log each run with its date and distance. Totals build up automatically and are saved in your browser.

When should running shoes be replaced?

Around 500–800 km for most trainers. This tool warns you at 500 km so you can start planning a replacement.

Is my data saved?

Yes — all data is stored in your browser's localStorage and never leaves your device.
